user.title: Set up PowerView Gen 3
user.description: Enter the address of the primary PowerView Gen 3 gateway: the one that is not an auxiliary gateway. It serves every shade of the home.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the primary gateway.

discovery_confirm.title: PowerView Gen 3 gateway found
discovery_confirm.description: Add the PowerView home of {name} at {host}?

reconfigure.title: Change the gateway's address
reconfigure.description: Change where the primary gateway is reached. It must be the same home's gateway.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the primary gateway.

error.cannot_connect: No PowerView Gen 3 gateway answers at this address.
error.not_primary: This is an auxiliary gateway. Enter the primary gateway instead ({primary}).

abort.already_configured: This PowerView home is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This PowerView home is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: No PowerView Gen 3 gateway answers at the discovered address.
abort.not_primary: The discovered gateway is an auxiliary gateway; the primary gateway serves the home.
abort.wrong_gateway: The gateway at this address belongs to another PowerView home. Add it as a new home instead.

data_description.motion_poll_interval: How often a moving shade's position is read. A shade standing still is never read.
data_description.refresh_minutes: How often every shade is read, in case an event from the gateway was missed.

cannot_connect.message: The PowerView gateway at {host} does not answer.

command_failed.message: The PowerView gateway did not take the command: {error}

no_position.message: Give a top or a bottom position, or both.

set_positions.name: Set positions
set_positions.description: Moves the top and bottom rails of a top-down/bottom-up shade in one command. A rail not given stays where it is.

top.name: Top
top.description: Where the top rail goes: 0 at the top, 100 fully down.

bottom.name: Bottom
bottom.description: Where the bottom rail goes: 0 fully down, 100 fully up.
